subject: Mutual action plan & security close timeline — SOC 2 / SIG-CAIQ / DPA / retention
messages:
From: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@crestline.com>
To: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Reed <oreed@crestline.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Initial: security gating + MAP for Crestline POC

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our security and procurement teams asked me to get a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) and a timeline for the POC close. Primary asks: SOC 2 evidence mapping, SIG/CAIQ self-assessment, DPA language & retention specifics (we need clarity on EU residency and 30/90/365-day archival options).

Procurement is pushing for the DPA redline to land before we do the legal review — they need it by Oct 8 to hit their internal meeting. Our audit team expects the CAIQ work to be completed before the POC signoff (target Oct 20).

Can you propose a short MAP with owners, deliverables, and dates? Also flag any blockers on Redwood's side (e.g., EU data residency options, evidence exports).

Thanks —
Patricia
Security Program Manager | Crestline Financial
[Attachment: Crestline-POC-ask-list.pdf (pdf)]

From: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@crestline.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial: security gating + MAP for Crestline POC

Hi Patricia —

Appreciate the clear asks. I put together a compact MAP and attached an editable spreadsheet (redwood-MAP-draft.xlsx) — high level below. We included owners from our side so you have single points of contact for each lane.

Proposed MAP (summary) —
- DPA redline (legal): Redwood to provide v1 redline by 2026-10-03 (owner: logan_wright). Crestline procurement review target: 2026-10-08.
- SOC 2 evidence index: Redwood to share evidence index and exports for in-scope controls by 2026-10-06 (owner: kimberly_park).
- SIG / CAIQ: Redwood will run the CAIQ self-assessment and share answers + supporting artifacts by 2026-10-14 (owner: soojin_lee).
- Data residency/retention clarifications: short doc with options (hosted-us, hosted-eu, or private VPC) and retention windows (30/90/365) by 2026-10-05 (owner: marissa_cole).
- Acceptance: mutual close checklist and signoff once artifacts verified (target: 2026-10-21).

Two logistical notes: (1) If procurement needs the DPA earlier, we can prioritize the redline to 10/02 but that will compress legal review on our end. (2) For EU residency, the hosted-eu option requires a quick scoping call to confirm region and SLA for data egress controls — can we schedule 30 minutes this week?

I've attached the MAP draft and a short SOC2 evidence index (SOC2-evidence-index.pdf) to give you a head start. Please confirm whether procurement's Oct 8 date is a hard milestone or flexible.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-MAP-draft.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@crestline.com>, logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial: security gating + MAP for Crestline POC

Patricia / Logan —

Quick note from security ops on the SOC 2 lane: attached is the index we plan to share and a short list of the artifacts that typically satisfy audit reviewers. 

SOC 2 evidence (high level) —
- Control mappings: list of sysadmin logs, change control docs, and access reviews (we will provide exported logs for the POC period).
- Configuration snapshots: container runtime configs and network ACLs (we will provide redacted config snapshots).
- Incident response runbook and recent tabletop notes (limited PII redacted).

SIG/CAIQ approach —
- We'll populate the CAIQ answers in the spreadsheet and highlight items needing Crestline validation (e.g., data classification). Target to drop CAIQ responses by 2026-10-14.

DPA redline —
- I reviewed the procurement ask: our Legal has a standard redline we can share (see DPA_redline_v1.docx). If Crestline needs a bespoke clause for escrow or longer retention carveouts, flag which clauses to focus on during review.

Blockers/risks —
- EU residency is available on Dedicated or Private, hosted-eu requires confirmation of region and data processing agreement addendum (we can deliver the addendum once we confirm region). This may add 3–5 business days if we need infra changes.

If it helps, we can run a short working session with Crestline audit (we do these as a 60-minute evidence walk-through).

-Kimberly
Security Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-evidence-index.pdf (pdf)]

From: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@crestline.com>
To: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Reed <oreed@crestline.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T14:41:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial: security gating + MAP for Crestline POC

Thanks Logan / Kimberly —

Procurement pushed back: Oct 8 is firm for receiving a DPA redline (they need it on the docket for their Oct 12 internal approvals meeting). Can your legal team commit to the 10/03 redline deliverable you proposed earlier? If you can get the redline to us 10/03 EOD PST we'll route it through procurement immediately.

On CAIQ: audit will accept a staged submission (answers first, supporting artifacts within one week). If you can deliver CAIQ Q&A by 10/14 and artifacts by 10/21, that aligns with our internal acceptance runway.

Retention / EU residency: Crestline requires the option for EU residency for cardholder-adjacent logs. We need details on whether that requires Dedicated or it can be fulfilled with hosted-eu with an addendum — Oliver, our infra lead, is on copy to validate technical constraints.

Could you also include an explicit acceptance checklist in the MAP that lists what artifacts will be considered PASS/FAIL for each control? That will speed signoff.

Patricia

Date: 2026-10-06T17:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial: security gating + MAP for Crestline POC — consolidated MAP & acceptance checklist

Patricia / Oliver —

Thanks for the clarity. Per procurement, we've accelerated the DPA lane. Summary of committed dates and acceptance criteria below (I updated the MAP spreadsheet and linked the working HubSpot engagement record).

Consolidated MAP (owners & dates) —
- 2026-10-02: Redwood legal delivered DPA_redline_v1.docx to Crestline (owner: logan_wright). [DELIVERED]
- 2026-10-06: SOC 2 evidence index (initial exports and control mappings) delivered (owner: kimberly_park). [DELIVERED]
- 2026-10-14: CAIQ Q&A submitted; artifacts to follow by 2026-10-21 (owner: soojin_lee).
- 2026-10-05: Data residency options doc (hosted-eu vs Dedicated vs Private) delivered (owner: marissa_cole). [DELIVERED]
- 2026-10-21: Mutual acceptance checklist signoff (target) — Crestline to mark PASS/FAIL per control using the acceptance checklist tab in the MAP spreadsheet.

Acceptance checklist (high level examples) —
- Control A: access review logs provided for the POC date range + reviewer notes => PASS if logs present and no critical failures.
- Control B: encrypted-at-rest proof + KMS key audit => PASS if KMS audit shows keys and rotation policy.
- CAIQ item: network segmentation — PASS if network ACL snapshots and diagram provided.

Blockers / Notes —
- EU residency: hosted-eu is available without infra changes but requires addendum for data processing. Dedicated / Private offers stricter isolation if Crestline prefers on-prem semantics. If you choose hosted-eu, we can deliver the addendum within 3 business days after you confirm region.
- If procurement needs the DPA to be signed before evidence review, let us know and we'll prioritize legal throughput.

Attachments delivered in thread: redwood-MAP-draft.xlsx; SOC2-evidence-index.pdf; DPA_redline_v1.docx.

Working links: https://hubspot.company/contacts/12345 (engagement record), https://drive.redwood/reports/MAP-template

Next step: I propose a 45-minute evidence walk-through on Monday (10/11) with Crestline audit and our security ops to run through the acceptance checklist. Please confirm availability.

Best,
Logan Wright
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
